entries.heading: STATEMENT OF APPROPRIATIONS
entries.text:
SEC. 5. STATEMENT OF APPROPRIATIONS.

    The following sums in this Act are appropriated, out of any money in 
the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the fiscal year ending 
September 30, 2022.

entries.heading: SENSE OF CONGRESS
ancestors: DIVISION W—VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN ACT REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2022
entries.text:
SEC. 5. SENSE OF CONGRESS.

    It is the sense of Congress--
            (1) that sex trafficking victims experience sexual violence 
        and assault; and
            (2) that Federal recognition of their recovery is important.
